collection.description: The collection's path, such as users or users/alice/orders.

collectionGroup.description: Instead of collection: a collection ID such as orders, to query every collection with that ID.

field.description: A field path such as status or address.city; a name with dots in backticks, `a.b`; __name__ for the document's path.

value.description: Plain JSON, or one Firestore typed value such as {"timestampValue": "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z"}. A list for in, not-in and array-contains-any. null and NaN compare with == and != only.

orderBy.description: The order of the documents, such as [{"field": "created", "direction": "desc"}]. Ordering by a field leaves out documents without it.

limit.description: Most documents to return; the endpoint caps it.

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous answer; leave it out for the first page.
